verse.verse_4: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
verse.verse_5: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
verse.verse_6: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
verse.verse_7: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
verse.verse_8: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
verse.verse_9: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
verse.verse_10: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
verse.verse_11: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
verse.verse_13: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
verse.verse_14: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
verse.verse_15: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
verse.verse_16: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
verse.verse_17: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
verse.verse_18: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
verse.verse_19: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
verse.verse_20: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
verse.verse_21: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
verse.verse_22: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
verse.verse_23: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
verse.verse_24: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
verse.verse_25: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
verse.verse_26: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
verse.verse_27: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
verse.verse_28: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
